name: Foreman
argument: I dissent from the 68 percent unchanged call, not from the caveat. The primary OPEC record proves the September adjustment, compensation obligations and the September 6 meeting clock, but it does not carry an October country table. Reuters supplies a sourced expectation of no October policy change; that is useful direction, not a settled barrel ledger. My counter-call is 46 percent for a clean unchanged October barrel ledger once the communique and any allocation or compensation table are posted, because a member-level reallocation, revised compensation schedule or capacity-baseline wording could move the accounting basis while leaving the headline policy label steady.
